entries.heading: EXTENSION OF REIMBURSEMENT AUTHORITY FOR FEDERAL CONTRACTORS
ancestors: TITLE IV—COMMITTEE ON HOMELAND SECURITY AND GOVERNMENTAL AFFAIRS
entries.text:
SEC. 4015. EXTENSION OF REIMBURSEMENT AUTHORITY FOR FEDERAL 
                          CONTRACTORS.

    Section 3610 of the CARES Act (Public Law 116-136; 134 Stat. 
414) is amended by striking 
``September 30, 2020'' and inserting ``September 30, 2021''.
